command: (async()=>{const u=new URL(location.href),p=u.searchParams,q=new URLSearchParams({limit:"10",offset:"0"});if(p.get("q"))q.set("q",p.get("q"));const r=await fetch("/api/executions?"+q.toString(),{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer "+localStorage.getItem("nodesteer_token")}}),d=await r.json();const labels=["等待中","运行中","成功","失败","已跳过","已取消","超时","已阻断"],ui=[...document.querySelectorAll("tbody tr")].map(tr=>{const txt=[...tr.querySelectorAll("td")].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()),paths=[...tr.querySelectorAll("a[href]")].map(a=>new URL(a.href).pathname),id=paths.map(x=>x.startsWith("/executions/")?x.split("/")[2]:null).find(Boolean)||null;return{id,status:labels.find(x=>txt.includes(x))||null,trigger:txt.find(x=>["手动","调度","系统"].includes(x))||null}});return JSON.stringify({url:location.href,q:p.get("q")||"",api_status:r.status,total:Number(r.headers.get("X-Total-Count")||0),api_ids:(d||[]).map(x=>x.id),ui_rows:ui,emptyState:document.querySelector("main")?.innerText.includes("没有匹配的执行记录")||false})})()
